question: Let $P = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$ and $Q = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$. Which of the following is true?
explanation:
$PQ = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{bmatrix}$
$PQ' = PQ$, symmetric.
$QP = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$
$QP' = QP$, symmetric.
Thus, both $PQ$ and $QP$ are symmetric.

options.A: $PQ$ is symmetric and $QP$ is skew symmetric
options.C: $PQ$ is skew symmetric and $QP$ is symmetric
